description: This file defines utility methods for handling credit card data, including masking credit card numbers and defining constants for card types.

classes.name: CreditCardUtils
classes.description: Utility class for credit card related operations, such as masking card numbers and defining card type constants.

methods.name: maskCardNumber
methods.description: Masks a credit card number by preserving the first 4 and last 4 digits and replacing the middle digits with X's. Throws an exception if the input length is less than 10.
